name: brand-naming
description: Run an adversarial naming sprint to find a defensible brand name for a company or product. Use when the user says "naming sprint", "find a name", "name my company", "name this product", "rebrand", "brand name", "escolher nome", "nomear a empresa", or asks to validate a shortlist of candidate names. Generates a large longlist, funnels it down with an explicit scorecard, then tries to destroy every survivor with collision research across software, dev ecosystems, companies, app stores, domains and trademarks before recommending anything. Refuses to recommend a name that has not been researched, and refuses to invent domain availability.
